# Third Party Notes

The client currently depends on these external components:

- `spice-client-glib` from spice-gtk, current local reference checkout: `third_party/spice-gtk-v0.37` in the parent workspace.
- virt-viewer v11.0, current local reference checkout: `third_party/virt-viewer-v11.0` in the parent workspace.
- GStreamer Windows runtime, currently stored in the parent workspace under `tools/`, but intentionally not committed here.

Fork/branch tracking is recorded in `docs/GITHUB_REPOS_AND_BRANCHES.md`.
